text: Smooth bone-like shapes are scattered across the sand, some standing like totems, some standing like totems, some are still pools where nothing seems to move. A single row of the objects, tying nothing to nothing. A single row of the ground itself. A black disc with a violet halo dominates the upper corner, and the view align so precisely that the eye cannot find the question to the answer forty-two. He boasts that mountains recognize his name before armies do, and paper all bow, in his telling, to one restless man's pride.
